anchor_file.description: The root anchor key file, that is read in and written out.

cert_file.description: The root update certificate file, that is read in.

server_host.description: The server name for the HTTPS connection.

server_port.description: The port number to use for the https connection.

xml_path.description: The pathname to the root-anchors.xml file on the server.

p7s_path.description: The pathname to the root-anchors.p7s file on the server.

signer_email.description: The emailAddress for the Subject of the signer's certificate from the p7s signature file.

bind_address.description: The source address to bind to for domain resolution and contacting the server.

use_ipv4_only.description: Use IPv4 for domain resolution and contacting the server on https.

use_ipv6_only.description: Use IPv6 for domain resolution and contacting the server on https.

disable_sni.description: Do not use SNI for the HTTPS connection.

resolv_conf.description: The resolv.conf file to use for resolution.

root_hints.description: The root.hints file to use to bootstrap domain resolution.

allow_fallback.description: Allow fallback from -f resolv.conf file to direct root servers query.

force_update.description: Force update of the root anchor through downloading the xml file.
